summary: Full backend + frontend testing for MSquare Care Solutions. 9/9 pytest backend tests passed (config, leads CRUD, admin auth, CSV export, Gemini image analyze, streaming chat). Full Playwright UI flow passed: landing loads, 7 service cards incl. General & Term/Life, floating WhatsApp href -> wa.me/918072571879, analyzer-run-btn disabled until file chosen, contact form submits successfully via Shadcn select, chat widget streams a real Gemini reply (~212 chars), and admin dashboard authenticates with passcode msquare2026 and displays the newly captured lead row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/leads returns Lead model whose 'id' (aliased to _id) is always null since to_mongo pops _id and inserted doc's _id is not read back. Harmless (client uses lead_id) but the 'id' field is dead weight — either remove or set from insert_one.inserted_id.
server.py: CSV export is XSS/CSV-injection safe-ish but does not escape embedded double quotes correctly (replaces " with '); consider RFC-4180 (double the quote).
server.py: /api/admin/leads/export accepts passcode as query param -> logged in access logs. Consider moving to header like the other admin endpoint for consistency.
ChatWidget.jsx: no error handling if res.body is null (e.g., non-2xx); should check res.ok before reading stream.
AdminPage.jsx: useEffect load(passcode) has eslint-disable and won't re-run when passcode changes (fine for now, but note it).
No rate-limiting on /api/leads or /api/chat — spam risk in production.
test_credentials: Admin passcode: msquare2026 (header X-Admin-Passcode or ?passcode= for CSV export)
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed leads via API + one via UI (e.g. TEST_UI_1787372658) during flow test. Left in DB as harmless test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. All 12 review items pass. Chat/analyze use real Gemini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY so allow up to 30s. Admin passcode stored in sessionStorage key 'msq_admin'. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
